name: kimi-coding-plan-multi
description: Kimi (Moonshot) Coding Plan with multiple API keys for load distribution. Each account gets its own group. Useful when you have several subscriptions with limited per-key quota.
keyInstructions: Subscribe to a Kimi Code plan at https://www.kimi.com/membership/pricing and create API keys at https://platform.kimi.com/console/api-keys. For each account, provide the key when prompted. Keys are stored separately in VS Code's keystore.
